svg.title: Nagoya Station — JR Conventional Lines
svg.desc: Floor-separated north-up schematic with ticket gates, platforms, elevators, accessible toilets and coin lockers. Geometry is simplified.

g.text: Tokaido, Chuo & Kansai lines / Separate north and south concourses / Toilets & coin lockers
Find your gate first, then follow your platform number.
Outside ticket gates · East–west public passage

Public elevator to Fashion One B1 / subway passage

NSK locker 10: Taikodori Exit / Umaimon Street

g.text: Access from the 1F passages shown at left.
Use the North Passage access points.
Dedicated routes may be used; follow
station signs or ask station staff.
North and south paid passages connect via the 2F platforms. The 1F Central Concourse is outside ticket gates.
Wheelchair icons = accessible toilets. Locker numbers = official NSK banks. Schematic locations.
